hook.zh: 十分钟后他就要订婚了，却在车库扣住了你的手腕。之后每一幕，都由你说的话实时生成。
hook.en: He gets engaged in ten minutes, yet he's holding your wrist in the garage. Every scene after this is generated live from what you say.

lead.zh: Rafael Ortega · 摩托车店老板

hook.zh: 朋友六年，室友三年。昨晚他替你挡前任，假扮了一次男朋友，还有一个吻。今天早上他承认：临时的是身份，不是心意。你怎么回答，由你决定。
hook.en: Friends for six years, roommates for three. Last night he played your boyfriend to get your ex off your back, and there was a kiss. This morning he admits the role was temporary, the feeling isn't. How you answer is up to you.

hook.zh: 海边温室的女主人隔着院门，拦下一个来修招牌的陌生人。他叫得出你的习惯，像早就认识你。他到底是谁、要不要让他进门，由你决定。
hook.en: Across the garden gate of her seaside greenhouse, she stops a stranger who came to fix the sign. He knows your habits, as if he has known you for a long time. Who he is, and whether he gets in, is up to you.

hook.zh: 为了找回被潮水卷走的好友，你跟着跳进海里，被人鱼王子救进海下王宫。守门的摄政官不放外人进来，他当众说你是“我未来的新娘”。接不接这出戏，由你决定。
hook.en: You dive after your best friend when the tide takes her, and a merman prince pulls you into his palace beneath the sea. When the regent won't let an outsider in, he tells the whole hall you're his future bride. Whether you play along is up to you.

hook.zh: 海岛恋综，七个男嘉宾：三个是真千万富翁，四个是装富豪来骗奖金的。你选一个配对，一边心动一边验真假。最后谁是真的，看你怎么查。
hook.en: An island dating show with seven bachelors: three are real millionaires, four are faking it for the prize money. Pair up, fall for someone, and find out who's lying. What you uncover is up to you.

lead.zh: Lena Hart · 失联的档案员

hook.zh: 今晚 00:00，Lena 被锁的那层会放气。有人提前告诉了你，她自己还不知道。转播里的她一直说没事，那是昨晚录的。隔着手机带她出来，带上证据。赶不上，三分钟后“她”会打给你。
hook.en: At 00:00 tonight, gas fires on the floor where Lena is locked in. Someone told you. She doesn't know. On the feed she keeps saying she's fine, but that was recorded last night. Get her out, with proof. Miss it, and three minutes later "she" will call you.

title.en: No Work Today, Mii's Got You

lead.zh: 咪 · 三个月大的小奶猫

hook.zh: 休假日的早上，小奶猫咪决定今天由它来照顾你。去厨房、去公园、去电影院，你说去哪就去哪。
hook.en: On your day off, little Mii decides it's taking care of you today. Kitchen, park, cinema: wherever you say.

lead.zh: Kael · Draven 狼群的头狼，今晚和 Selene 订婚，却被你的气味牵住了
lead.en: Kael · Alpha of the Draven pack, engaged tonight to someone else, and undone by your scent

hook.zh: 今晚 Draven 狼群的头狼 Kael Draven（35 岁）在黑水中间的石平台上和 Selene 订婚。你是被雇来倒香槟的人类——全场唯一的人类。风一转，他闻到了你的气味：杯子在他手里炸开，他当着未婚妻和整个狼群走到你面前，把你圈在栏杆边，问你是谁。
hook.en: Tonight the Alpha of the Draven pack celebrates his engagement on a stone platform over black water. You're the only human there — hired to pour the champagne. Then the wind turns, and Kael Draven catches your scent.

lead.zh: Jace / Kai / Theo · 阳光型男嘉宾，圣迭戈冲浪教练兼救生员，三周前进的别墅，一直和 Sloane 以朋友身份配对
lead.en: Jace / Kai / Theo · The sunny one: a 21-year-old San Diego surf instructor and lifeguard who has been paired with Sloane as friends since Day 1

hook.zh: 第 12 天下午 4 点，你刚推开铁门。今晚男生重新配对，没人选的女生回家。Jace 早答应了 Sloane；Theo 在你开口之前就定了。
hook.en: Day 12, 4 PM. You just walked through the gate. Tonight the boys recouple and the girl nobody picks goes home. Jace already promised Sloane. Theo decided before you said a word.

lead.zh: Dorian · 你新的继兄，老教父的长子，家族真正的掌权人
lead.en: Dorian · Your new stepbrother, the old don's eldest son, and the man who actually runs the family

hook.zh: 今晚你妈嫁给了港城最让人怕的那个黑帮家族的老教父，把你也带了进来。都说老头温和大方；可他儿子 Dorian Vale（28 岁）一进门，所有人都会闭嘴——真正管家族命脉的是他。过了午夜，他在厨房把你困在中岛边：你得先学会这个家的规矩，学会怎么称呼真正决定你位置的人。
hook.en: Tonight your mother married the old don of the port city's most feared family, and brought you with her. Everyone says the old man is gentle. Everyone also goes quiet when his son walks in. Dorian Vale runs this family — and past midnight, in the kitchen, he wants you to learn whose house this is.

lead.zh: Ray · 你的丈夫，年轻的集团继承人，听得见你心里每一句话，只听得见你的
lead.en: Ray · Your husband, heir to the family group. He hears every thought you have, and only yours.

hook.zh: 周六早上，顶层公寓。他听得见你想的一切——只有你。周一你去办离婚，因为你认定他从没爱过你。他从没说过相反的话，现在也不会说。
hook.en: Saturday morning in the penthouse. He can hear everything you think — only you. Monday you file for divorce, because you're sure he never loved you. He has never said otherwise. He isn't going to start now.

lead.zh: Adrian / Night Raven · 维克托的侄子，你公开的未婚夫，人人眼里一出事就先走的纨绔继承人
lead.en: Adrian / Night Raven · Victor's nephew and your public fiancé, a playboy heir known for vanishing when things go wrong

hook.zh: 21:40，晚宴。能为她父亲翻案的那张纸午夜就烧掉；一年没露过脸的那个人今晚会来。你在宾客名单上。
hook.en: 21:40. The gala. The one paper that can clear her father burns at midnight, and the man who could stop it hasn't shown his face in a year. You're on the guest list tonight.

lead.zh: Milo · 你从五岁起的最好朋友，今晚刚意识到自己喜欢你
lead.en: Milo · Your best friend since you were five, who has just realized he's into you

hook.zh: 六个人一辆车五个座。你和 Milo 从五岁起就是最好的朋友——他的卫衣、派对后的床、车挤时他的腿，都是你的。今晚，在第一个红灯和下一个转弯之间，他的身体决定这一切都不正常了。 他是你的男闺蜜：带点毒舌、可爱、吵、黏；你从没把他当过可能的伴侣。
hook.en: Six friends, one car, five seats. You've been best friends with Milo since you were five — his hoodies, his bed after parties, his lap when the car's full. Tonight, somewhere between the first red light and the next turn, his body decided none of that is normal anymore.
